citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana tears Razaketh apart.
timeline.quote: she tore him apart and let her undead feast on his remains

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana betrays the Gatewatch and flees Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Liliana betrayed her friends and fled to another plane

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Temmet finds Jace and Liliana in the embalming chambers; Jace takes control of his mind so they can flee.
timeline.quote: Jace took control of his mind, allowing the two planeswalkers to flee.

citation.text: "Temmet", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
timeline.quote: My third demon is here.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The demon calls out for Liliana Vess, saying she cannot hide.
timeline.quote: I know you are here, Liliana Vess. You cannot hide from me.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana waits at the bloody Luxa and contacts Jace in her mind as Razaketh calls out for her.
timeline.quote: Jace? Can you hear me?

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh scans the crowd and Liliana finds her hand moving involuntarily.
timeline.quote: The movement of her hand had been . . . involuntary.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh spots Liliana and the Gatewatch arrive, bruised from the arena.
timeline.quote: Liliana saw the rest of the Gatewatch arrive.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh commands Liliana to come to him, and her body wades into the river of blood against her will; Chandra and Nissa are repelled by necromantic energy.
timeline.quote: her body waded forward into the river of blood.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana is forced beneath the surface of the blood river, and the Raven Man tells her she can only survive if she kills the demon.
timeline.quote: You are only free if you kill each of your demons, Liliana.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana's body swims itself across to the Necropolis bank, where Razaketh stands smugly above her.
timeline.quote: She had crossed the river and crawled onto the opposite bank.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh toys with Liliana, making her kneel, nod and bark, and tells her he has fulfilled a friend's assignment.
timeline.quote: I love a dog who comes when she is called.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana regains her speech and tells Razaketh he has five minutes to live, then counts down to stall until her allies arrive.
timeline.quote: You have five more minutes to live,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra engulfs Razaketh in fire at Liliana's signal, and he rams her into the Necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: a jet of fire engulfed the demon.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh dislocates Liliana's shoulder and silences her until Nissa's elemental breaks his concentration.
timeline.quote: A massive elemental emerged, its body forming from the banks of the river.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh stops Liliana's breathing and paralyzes her as Chandra takes aim at him.
timeline.quote: She tried to suck in air, but her diaphragm was completely still.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, camouflaged by Jace, slashes Razaketh's back with his sural, freeing Liliana's breath and shielding her with his invulnerability.
timeline.quote: carving three thick lines in Razaketh's back.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks Razaketh's control over Liliana's mind.
timeline.quote: Got him, move fast,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws the Chain Veil but puts it away, choosing to defeat Razaketh with her own power.
timeline.quote: Let the demon witness what terror she could wield all on her own.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the dead animals of the river against Razaketh and blasts him down.
timeline.quote: a menagerie of death spilled up and out of the river of blood.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana possesses two dozen dead crocodiles and devours Razaketh, killing him.
timeline.quote: her two dozen selves consumed the last of the demon Razaketh.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace is horrified as Liliana laughs and relishes the killing, and he tells her to stop.
timeline.quote: Liliana, that's enough

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana releases the crocodiles, which swim away reanimated by the Curse of Wandering.
timeline.quote: The Curse of Wandering had taken hold.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace she ate Razaketh and that only one demon remains; Jace does not answer.
timeline.quote: And now there's just one more.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
timeline.quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he will not stand by if she loses control like that again.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to stand by if you lose it like that again.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra glimpses Gideon and Liliana running past, and Djeru tells her not to stop.
timeline.quote: One was Gideon, the broad-shouldered warrior Oketra had claimed as one of her own.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas tells Liliana he can take away all the power she has gathered.
timeline.quote: All the power you have gathered for yourself, Liliana, I can take away.

citation.text: Liliana's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana came to Amonkhet to confront a demon to whom she is bound.
timeline.quote: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

citation.text: Razaketh, the Foulblooded (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch strike down the demon Razaketh, sparing Liliana from using the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: the planeswalkers struck the demon down swiftly, sparing Liliana from resorting to the hated power of the Chain Veil .

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas shows Liliana the Chain Veil is no match, shows Nissa that the cycle of life is poisoned, and crushes Chandra in his claws.
timeline.quote: where he snuffed out her fire and crushed her nearly lifeless in his claws.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Devastion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats the Gatewatch on Amonkhet; Gideon, Chandra, Nissa and Liliana flee.
timeline.quote: Gideon fled too, leaving Bolas victorious.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
timeline.quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana, shaken by Jace's scream, is torn between the Chain Veil's urging and the Raven Man's counsel as Bolas taunts her.
timeline.quote: Yes, use us. Unleash your full power

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
timeline.quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
timeline.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana vanishes into the void as Chandra screams at her betrayal.
timeline.quote: She surrounded herself in a glowing nimbus of dark energy and vanished into the void

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that Liliana never called him incredible, unlike Vraska.
timeline.quote: Liliana never told Jace he was incredible.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace chooses to track Gideon rather than Liliana to reach Dominaria.
timeline.quote: What he felt for her now wasn't anything resembling affection.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dominaria coalesced around Gideon and the first thing that struck him was the stench of rotting plants and dank earth.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, wounded in the shoulder, admits the battle against Bolas did not go to plan.
timeline.quote: The second thing Gideon noticed was the hole in his shoulder and its piercing pain.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks where Jace is and Nissa says he has given up.
timeline.quote: He's given up.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Nissa accuses Liliana of running after killing her demon Razaketh and using the group to free herself.
timeline.quote: You got what you wanted and ran.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits her last demon, Belzenlok, is on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok is here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks Nissa to rouse Yavimaya's treefolk against the Cabal's Stronghold while she uses the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: And I can use the Chain Veil to kill him.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Nissa refuses and walks away, declaring her watch over.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry, but my watch is over.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Nissa planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nissa was already stepping out of the plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra announces she will leave to become stronger.
timeline.quote: I'm going too.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks away in a rush of fire.
timeline.quote: Her form disappeared in a rush of fire as she walked from the plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon decides to stay and work with Liliana.
timeline.quote: I'm staying.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the town is her birthplace.
timeline.quote: It's where I was born.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: At the inn, Liliana tends Gideon's wound while the innkeeper says the Cabal has taken over the region.
timeline.quote: It's the Cabal,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The innkeeper says the Church of Serra was routed by the Cabal in a battle days earlier.
timeline.quote: The Church of Serra came to help and there was a great battle only a few days ago, but the Cabal routed us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks a girl if anyone remembers the House of Vess.
timeline.quote: Does anyone here remember the House of Vess?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gathering herbs, Liliana remembers meeting the Raven Man in the marsh.
timeline.quote: This was where she had first met the Raven Man.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls how her attempt to heal Josu raised him as an undead who killed Lady Ana before she fled as her spark ignited (flashback).
timeline.quote: She had meant only to heal him, and instead turned him into a mindless undead monster that killed Lady Ana, killed her servants

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Vess Manor still standing.
timeline.quote: The house was still here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds charred necromantic symbols and blood, convincing her it was no coincidence.
timeline.quote: Whatever had happened here, it was no coincidence.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Cabal undead knights attack the town at nightfall.
timeline.quote: She had barely started on the path through the ruins when she sensed the surge of undead malice.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana destroys a dozen knights with necromantic bolts.
timeline.quote: As the etchings on her skin flared violet, bolts shot out from her hands to strike a dozen black-armored knights.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana seizes an undead knight and saves Gideon.
timeline.quote: In the next instant, he was hers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tracing the knight's connection, Liliana sees the lich's face is Josu's.
timeline.quote: An image of the lich's face burned before her. The face was Josu's.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A captured cleric reveals Belzenlok made Josu his servant and commander of his forces.
timeline.quote: He has made your precious brother into his servant, the commander of his unholy forces!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The cleric dies after saying the Void awaits.
timeline.quote: and slumped lifeless on the pavement.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to free Josu and make Belzenlok pay.
timeline.quote: You'll pay for this, Belzenlok,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana searches the Morass for the Raven Man, shouting for him to face her.
timeline.quote: I know you're here! Face me, damn you!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man appears from a swirl of ravens.
timeline.quote: Out of that mass stepped the Raven Man.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man says Josu cannot be laid to rest and that Liliana should have followed him.
timeline.quote: It can't be done.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man vanishes with his ravens.
timeline.quote: he and every raven in sight abruptly vanished.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Belzenlok used Josu to make her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him.
timeline.quote: He knew if Liliana used the Chain Veil to unmake Josu, it would leave her so weak she wouldn't be able to use it to destroy Belzenlok.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Gideon the lich leading the Cabal is her brother Josu.
timeline.quote: The lich leading the Cabal forces in this area is my brother, Josu.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana confesses she made Josu undead as a girl.
timeline.quote: I made Josu undead, many years ago.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to help lay Josu to rest as the next step.
timeline.quote: Yes, that's our next step, obviously.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana find Rael in a ruin and offer help against the Cabal.
timeline.quote: We know you're Rael, Battle Angel and Protector of Caligo.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Rael accepts and asks to hear their plan.
timeline.quote: Tell me your plan.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Corin to make a dread shade mistake him for a skin witch.
timeline.quote: Corin, with Liliana's help, could you create an illusion? Make a dread shade think I'm a skin witch?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls to Josu through the wind, drawing him to the manor.
timeline.quote: Josu Vess, I am here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu appears in spiked dark armor as Belzenlok's lich general.
timeline.quote: The magic that had transformed him from a mindless undead remnant into Belzenlok's lich general had covered his shape with dark metal armor.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws on the Chain Veil, killing undead across the Morass.
timeline.quote: The Onakke bound into the Chain Veil whispered in her mind as she drew on raw power.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Veil destroys Josu, leaving his decomposing corpse.
timeline.quote: crumpled before her on the paving stones was the decomposing corpse of her brother.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: With his last words Josu blames Liliana for the curse of the House of Vess.
timeline.quote: You killed me. You killed them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes her family died trying to end the evil she created.
timeline.quote: And worse still, her family, all dead trying to end the evil she had created.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to destroy Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: I will pry open his Stronghold, slaughter his grimnants, and destroy his legacy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra Dawnbringer refuses Liliana entry to Benalia City.
timeline.quote: Your companion stinks of death magic and will not be allowed into this city.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra relents after reading Rael's letter vouching for Liliana.
timeline.quote: Very well. You may enter the city.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight descends to the signal tower to pick up Gideon and Liliana.
timeline.quote: as the giant skyship dropped down toward them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani scolds Gideon and Liliana for going to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: You should not have gone to Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon says they failed on Amonkhet because Liliana's demon pact held her back.
timeline.quote: But we failed on Amonkhet because Liliana was still hamstrung by her demon pact.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana angrily reveals how much Caligo's ruin matters to her.
timeline.quote: You didn't see what he did to Caligo!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers the Weatherlight's help to destroy Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: I've had this ship reconstructed for the sole purpose of fighting the Cabal

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group resolves to capture a high-level Cabal agent for intelligence about the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We need to capture a high-level Cabal agent.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira tenses when she sees her ex-lover Jodah at the academy.
timeline.quote: Just an ex-lover I wasn't expecting to see today.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah brings them to see something at the academy.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure how much we can help you, but there's something we'd like you to take a look at.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana animates a dead student to question it; nine victims were killed by dementia magic.
timeline.quote: Lying on the floor were nine corpses, students and staff of the academy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana concludes a Cabal cleric used dementia magic.
timeline.quote: It's dementia magic all around, I'm afraid,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna argues the killings are not how Cabal agents operate.
timeline.quote: I've hunted Cabal agents in the cities of Jamuraa, and this is not how they operate.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the laboratory itself was the agent's target.
timeline.quote: This place was the target all along.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Gideon and Shanna subdue Thom.
timeline.quote: She knocked him flat and Gideon stepped forward to kick the magical device away from his hand.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she sees Josu all the time now.
timeline.quote: I see Josu all the time, now.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira describes the Blackblade as a soul-drinker made with death magic.
timeline.quote: But it's a soul-drinker, created with death magic, and steals the life-energy of everyone it kills.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon refuses to use a soul-drinker under any circumstances.
timeline.quote: A soul-drinker is not something we would want to use, under any circumstances.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira says she knows a time mage who can help.
timeline.quote: But I know just the time mage who can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces Gideon and Liliana as planeswalkers to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Liliana are Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Liliana mistakes can eventually be balanced.
timeline.quote: It isn't possible to erase them, but with effort you can eventually balance your account.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira theorizes Urza cheated, and Liliana looks for ghosts in the chamber.
timeline.quote: Worse, I think he cheated,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana detects trapped spirits that factor into the puzzle.
timeline.quote: Aha, there are spirits here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi hits the correct square and the platform opens.
timeline.quote: the square in the center slid ponderously aside to reveal an opening.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The monument begins to collapse.
timeline.quote: I think this place is collapsing!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess sends her brother into sleep as her final gift.
timeline.quote: "Sleep now, brother. That is the one gift I can give you."

citation.text: Final Parting (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess confronts someone who bound her with a contract only death could end.
timeline.quote: "You bound me with a contract only your death could end

citation.text: Settle the Score (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana arrive on Dominaria after the Gatewatch's defeat by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Liliana have arrived on Dominaria following the Gatewatch ’s defeat at the hands of Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Dominaria", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana begin a mission to kill Belzenlok, the final demon holding Liliana's contract.
timeline.quote: Together, they begin a mission to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Dominaria", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa leaves the Gatewatch after losing Jace and angered by Liliana.
timeline.quote: The shock of losing Jace, as well as the anger towards Liliana's actions, caused Nissa to leave the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the Cabal's stronghold and kills Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: managed to defeat the Cabal's Stronghold and kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana falls under Bolas's control through her demon pact.
timeline.quote: Liliana, who fell under the control of Nicol Bolas due to her pact with the demons that he had brokered

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana defeat Belzenlok on Dominaria, with Gideon killing him using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: which he ultimately used to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Only Gideon stays with Liliana after Nissa and Chandra leave.
timeline.quote: Only Gideon chose to remain with her.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana learns the Cabal's master is her brother, transformed into a lich.
timeline.quote: she learned that their master was no other than her brother Josu, who had been transformed into a Lich by Belzenlok's cultists

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana destroys the lich of her brother.
timeline.quote: The enraged Lich left his hideout to confront her, only for Liliana to destroy him.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok is killed with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: together they managed to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas inherits Liliana's contract and takes her off Dominaria.
timeline.quote: With all four demons dead, the contract had defaulted to its broker, Bolas himself.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa renounces her oath and returns to Zendikar, leaving the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Nissa renounced her oath and returned to Zendikar, unwilling to lend further aid to the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra recognizes Gideon and Liliana aboard the Weatherlight as they call the group to come aboard.
timeline.quote: "Gideon!" She waved wildly.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon and Chandra to leave with him and says Liliana cannot be trusted, but Gideon refuses and Chandra chooses to stay.
timeline.quote: You don't understand. You can't trust her.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: If we can find it in the Stronghold, I'll use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Gideon argue over whether Gideon should have told Chandra about Josu to push her to help kill Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Because she agrees with us that it has to be done before we face Nicol Bolas again.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot and its sprouts leave their den and meet Liliana, who asks Arvad how he resisted drinking blood.
timeline.quote: How did you decide not to eat people?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad explains he held on to an image of himself before he was changed, and Liliana learns there is no trick; she threatens Tiana and Arvad not to tell anyone about the talk.
timeline.quote: And if you tell anyone we had this conversation, you'll both regret it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Urborg resistance's hidden base and that her owl has arranged a meeting.
timeline.quote: And the resistance has agreed to meet with us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff casts an illusion that gives Chandra a sword scar for her Cabal bounty hunter disguise.
timeline.quote: Her skin puckered and pulled, creating a sword scar that ran from one side of her forehead to her jaw.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana says she wants her pact removed and Belzenlok in pieces.
timeline.quote: I want this pact off my body. I want Belzenlok in pieces.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls the dead of an old massacre site to raise an undead army as a diversion.
timeline.quote: And in the grass and reeds and brush below, the dead stirred.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana's panther liches pledge to follow the Weatherlight into battle.
timeline.quote: They'll follow the ship into battle.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle rises from the swamp, a living creature that killed all the panther warriors, and flings itself at the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then Yargle roared and flung itself at the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana saves Jhoira from falling from the tilting deck.
timeline.quote: Liliana managed to wedge herself between the deck and the rail, gripping Jhoira's arm to keep her from falling.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental, rises behind Yargle and seizes it.
timeline.quote: It's Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira directs the ship to the Stronghold after Slimefoot's call for help succeeds.
timeline.quote: Jhoira agreed. It was time to end this. "To the Stronghold."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
timeline.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros rises from the volcano on a dragon-like mount to attack the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: I think that's Urgoros!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana deflects Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and Jaya, Karn, Tiana and Arvad drive it off the ship.
timeline.quote: Tiana suddenly landed in front of her.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira realizes Urgoros is only a distraction, and the spirits build a tower of bodies to lower Liliana to the ground.
timeline.quote: They kept coming, the tower of spirit bodies rising higher and higher.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana taunts Belzenlok about her brother and the pact signers she has killed to draw him away from Gideon.
timeline.quote: You should have left my brother alone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana grabs the hilt.
timeline.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Belzenlok's life with the Blackblade and kills him; his body collapses into lumps of flesh.
timeline.quote: What was left of Belzenlok collapsed into lumps of white flesh.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds the lines of her pact are still on her skin after Belzenlok's death.
timeline.quote: but the lines of her pact were still written on her skin.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals that Liliana's pact defaults to its broker, himself, when her demons die, and he threatens that disobedience will kill her.
timeline.quote: You seem unaware that with your demons dead, your contract defaults to its broker.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas planeswalks away and Liliana follows, resolved to find an escape while staying alive.
timeline.quote: Sick at heart, bound like a prisoner to a new incarnation of a fate she had schemed so long to cheat, Liliana followed in his wake.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon returns to the empty Stronghold court, finds Liliana's aether trail leading away from the others, and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She had left Dominaria, but she hadn't followed him and the others.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess commands the dead to obey.
timeline.quote: "Death is no excuse for disobedience."

citation.text: Rise from the Grave (Core Set 2019, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess prefers fresh corpses.
timeline.quote: "I'm not picky about what comes up, but the less decay, the better."

citation.text: Arisen Gorgon (Core Set 2019, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess approves of what has been done to the Grim Backwoods.
timeline.quote: "I love what they've done with the place."

citation.text: Grim Backwoods (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ral learns of four planeswalkers on Ravnica and of Vraska, and warns Jace at a Rakdos Carnarium; Liliana reports Tezzeret on Kaladesh and Jace leaves with Gideon.
timeline.quote: Jace fetched Gideon and left Ravnica behind

citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana seizes the reins of Bolas's vast army while wearing the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army

citation.text: Command the Dreadhorde (War of the Spark Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana betrays Bolas and takes command of his Dreadhorde while wearing the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army, gritting her teeth behind the Chain Veil.

citation.text: Command the Dreadhorde (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana defies Bolas, forfeiting her life under her contract but choosing her own fate.
timeline.quote: The moment Liliana defied Nicol Bolas, her contract was broken, and her life was forfeit.

citation.text: Price of Betrayal (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana whispers to Oketra and Bontu's remaining consciousness to turn on Bolas.
timeline.quote: "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

citation.text: Despark (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself; the cost of betraying Bolas does not fall on Liliana.
timeline.quote: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

citation.text: Gideon's Sacrifice (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria, Rat helps find Liliana, defeat an imposter, and persuade Kaya to let Liliana live.
timeline.quote: Rat helped convince Kaya to let Liliana live

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana seizes control of Bontu and Oketra and orders them to attack Bolas.
timeline.quote: she seized control of Bontu and Oketra

citation.text: "Bontu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices his life to save Liliana; Chandra believes Liliana killed him and is stopped by Jace.
timeline.quote: When Gideon sacrificed his life to save Liliana, Chandra misunderstood what had happened, believing Liliana had killed him.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas saves Liliana from the assassination attempt by destroying the buildings under Jace's team.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself, taking the demons' contract on himself to save Liliana.
timeline.quote: Gideon sacrificed himself to save her, using his hieromancy to take the contract and its lethal effects upon himself

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself to save Liliana by taking her demonic contract upon himself and dies.
timeline.quote: Gideon sacrificed himself to save her

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana, freed, turns the God-Eternals on Bolas and, with Niv-Mizzet's distraction, despark him.
timeline.quote: Gideon's sacrifice was the deciding factor in the battle

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien volunteer to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: Jace, Jaya, Teferi, and Vivien volunteered to assassinate Liliana.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace witnesses Gideon sacrificing his life to save Liliana.
timeline.quote: Jace witnessed Gideon sacrificing his life to save Liliana.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska break up after Vraska accuses him of still loving Liliana.
timeline.quote: They broke up after Vraska accused him of still having feelings for Liliana.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien try to assassinate Liliana and nearly succeed until Bolas destroys the buildings and saves her; Teferi saves the others.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya joins the Gatewatch to atone and is assigned to assassinate Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: Seeking to atone for her past mistakes, she joined the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas makes Liliana general of his Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: Bolas installed Liliana as his Dreadhorde 's general

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana, controlling Oketra, deliberately misses Gideon.
timeline.quote: Liliana directly controlled Oketra in shooting down Gideon

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, breaking her contract.
timeline.quote: she turned all the Eternals against Bolas

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon transfers the contract to himself and ages to dust to save Liliana.
timeline.quote: Gideon used hieromancy to transfer the contract and its lethal effects upon himself

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas brokers Liliana's contract with four demons.
timeline.quote: Bolas proceeded to act as a broker for four demons to form a contract with her

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Liliana's contract". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana turns the Dreadhorde on Bolas; he invokes her contract and Gideon sacrifices himself to save her.
timeline.quote: Gideon then sacrificed himself to save Liliana from the contract.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas through the back with Hazoret's spear while Bolas is under attack; Bontu then extracts all of Bolas's sparks.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet surprised Nicol Bolas by impaling the elder dragon through the back with Hazoret's spear.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The New Living Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As his first act, Niv-Mizzet sends Ral, Vraska and Kaya to hunt down Tezzeret, Dovin and Liliana as penance.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet's first act as Living Guildpact was to have Ral, Vraska , and Kaya undergo penance for allying with Bolas but defecting before the War

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The New Living Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under Liliana's command Oketra shoots at Gideon, but Liliana makes the arrow hit his Pegasus instead.
timeline.quote: Liliana interfered, causing the Divine Arrow to miss and impale Gideon's Pegasus instead

citation.text: "Oketra", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana commands Oketra and Bontu to attack Bolas; Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas, Bolas obliterates Oketra, and Bontu despark him.
timeline.quote: Bolas managed to obliterate Oketra

citation.text: "Oketra", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The guildmasters hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana Vess as penance.
timeline.quote: The Living Guildpact and the other guildmasters hired Kaya to assassinate Liliana Vess as penance for previously working with Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra reactivates the Immortal Sun and leaves Saheeli to guard it; after Bolas's defeat Saheeli disables it again on Jace's unknown plan to let Ugin and Liliana leave.
timeline.quote: After Bolas' defeat, Saheeli disabled the Immortal Sun for a second time.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Bolas's defeat Liliana picks up the Spirit-Gem before planeswalking away.
timeline.quote: After Bolas's defeat, Liliana Vess picked up the Spirit-Gem before she planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin speaks through the Gem to Araithia and appears to Liliana, telling her she must choose her path to redemption.
timeline.quote: Ugin briefly spoke through the Gem to Araithia Shokta and appeared to Liliana Vess

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Holding the Gem and the Chain Veil, Liliana sees the Gem glow and disappear; she drops the Veil and the Gem returns to Ugin.
timeline.quote: The Gem returned to Ugin.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's team nearly assassinates Liliana but Bolas saves her; Teferi slows their falls.
timeline.quote: Teferi saved himself and the other three Planeswalkers by slowing their falls.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria Teyo frees Liliana from her trance and deduces that the fake Liliana draws power from a bound djinn.
timeline.quote: Teyo attempted to remove the gold collar from Liliana's neck, which jolted her back to her senses

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat destroys the amulet freeing Zahid, who tries to kill Teyo; Liliana subdues Zahid with the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana then used the Chain Veil to subdue Zahid and save Teyo.

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana is allowed to live; Teyo transports the Veil to Ravnica as proof of her death, and Niv-Mizzet locks it in a puzzle box.
timeline.quote: Liliana was allowed to live, although proof of a kill would be needed.

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo travels with Kaya and Rat to Fiora to join Liliana, now called Ana Iora, on her path to redemption.
timeline.quote: Liliana, who had changed her name to Ana Iora

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the War of the Spark Gideon sacrifices himself for Liliana as she turns against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura sacrifices himself for Liliana while she turns against Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin speaks to Araithia and Liliana through the Spirit-Gem, and Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien, Jace, Jaya and Teferi nearly assassinate Liliana, but Bolas saves her by destroying the buildings.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret opens the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet, letting Liliana lead the Dreadhorde through, and destroys the Embassy of the Guildpact, making Jace lose the Living Guildpact power.
timeline.quote: causing Jace to lose the power of the Living Guildpact

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien nearly assassinate Liliana, but Bolas intervenes to save her.
timeline.quote: They almost succeed, but Bolas intervenes to save her.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oketra, controlled by Liliana, shoots down Gideon's pegasus, Liliana choosing to hit the pegasus rather than Gideon.
timeline.quote: Liliana, who chooses to 'miss' by hitting the pegasus instead of Gideon himself

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana betrays Bolas; he cancels her demonic pact, and Gideon uses hieromancy to take the contract himself, dying in her place.
timeline.quote: Gideon uses his hieromancy to transfer the contract to himself, killing him in her place.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana frees Oketra and Bontu, who attack Bolas of their own volition.
timeline.quote: Liliana frees the God-Eternals Oketra and Bontu , who attack Bolas of their own volition.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ral, Kaya and Vraska are told to atone by bringing Bolas' other planeswalkers to justice.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet and the other guild leaders declare that Ral, Kaya, and Vraska must atone for helping Bolas.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A raven-haired woman puts on a golden veil, her skin glows with purple tattoos, and she commands the marching Eternal army to slaughter the crowd.
timeline.quote: the army stopped as one and turned to look her way

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The raven-haired woman watches the planeswalkers and Rat fight, then leaves for the pyramid.
timeline.quote: her shaking her head in pity, if not disgust

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out five problems: the Beacon, the Immortal Sun, the Planar Bridge, Liliana Vess, and Bolas himself.
timeline.quote: We face a number of problems. Five to be exact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace identifies Liliana Vess as controlling the Eternals for Bolas and says she must be stopped forever, to Gideon's silence.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess. She's clearly controlling the Eternals for Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana and the God-Eternal Oketra shoot Gideon's pegasus, and he falls behind the Citadel.
timeline.quote: Instead its six-foot length impaled his mount.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, switching sides.
timeline.quote: I knew then that Miss Raven-Hair had switched sides.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana begins to disintegrate; Gideon heals her by taking her death into himself and is destroyed.
timeline.quote: In exchange, her black death was transferring over to him.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
